reasoning: A hybrid strategy balances autonomous reasoning with robust external explainability tools to provide both domain-informed insights and statistically grounded feature importance. tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides reliable, calibrated, and interpretable feature attributions for tabular models. LIME offers local interpretability with sufficient sample coverage. Integrated Gradients give gradient-based attribution from baseline to prediction, ensuring consistency. Sensitivity analysis verifies feature impact through ablation, adding robustness to the findings. Together, they cover both theoretical and empirical dimensions of feature importance in tabular data.
